title: The heavens and the earth in the text's own words
opening_question: What does the text itself say about the shape of the earth, the firmament and what holds the earth?
note: Only the text, the word meanings and questions. BibleChat gives no verdict.

steps.question: What is the firmament, where are the lights set, and what is above and below it?
How do these verses describe the sky?
Which words describe the shape: circle, compass, ball, corners? Read each one in its own sentence.
What does the earth hang on or rest on? Read the verses about nothing, foundations and pillars side by side.
What do these verses say about the earth being moved, and about the sun?
The Book of the Luminaries (Ethiopian Canon): how does it describe the sun, moon and stars and their gates?
